I couldn't reproduce this. Maybe you saved some file while the build was running?

The cargo process is killed and restarted when you changed some file on the src-tauri directory, so this isn't really an issue (but it's weird that it happened on the first run). The code that restarts the cargo process can be found here: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/b2ed00087d902e575a15a391e9e4a6a9a77c3567/tooling/cli.rs/src/dev.rs#L142

I'll close this issue since this is not exactly a problem, but let me know if you can find anything (for instance what file triggered the restart if you didn't save a file while cargo was running) :)

Also you can disable this by running `tauri dev --exit-on-panic` (short version: `tauri dev -e`).

This is a bad flag name, should probably be renamed to `fail-fast` or something.
